rule.description: A class declaration that all at once declares at least 36 own non-static member functions, owns at least 10 own non-static instance-state properties, and spans at least 280 source lines: one owner that centralizes several distinct responsibilities behind a single interface (a God Class).

checks.description: Detect classes that centralize too much functionality: at least 36 own member functions, at least 10 own instance-state properties and at least 280 class-body lines of consolidated responsibilities in a single declaration.
checks.detected_relation: single class <- responsibilities absorbed from several surrounding single-purpose collaborators
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Such a class violates single responsibility: it simultaneously owns action binding registration, value-change propagation, target and outlet matched/unmatched bookkeeping, or scope/module registry maintenance and event-listener table custody, together with its original lifecycle, error-handling and logging duties, so distinct responsibilities are no longer separated into cohesive classes.

matches.evidence: Context declares 62 own member functions and 14 own instance-state properties across a 557-line class body. It directly implements the value-list, string-map, token-list, attribute and selector delegate protocols of the DOM observation layer: it observes action attributes and maintains the binding registry (connectAction/disconnectAction/disconnectAllActions over bindingsByAction), propagates controller value changes (invokeChangedCallback and the stringMapKey* delegate methods over stringMapObserver and valueDescriptorMap), connects and disconnects targets (connectTarget/disconnectTarget over targetsByName and a lazy tokenListObserver), and runs outlet selector/attribute observation (connectOutlet/disconnectOutlet, per-outlet selectorObserverMap and attributeObserverMap with an own outletObservationStarted flag), in addition to owning the controller instance, scope, lifecycle forwarding, error relay and debug logging.

Application declares 38 own member functions and 10 own instance-state properties across a 296-line class body. It inlines the scope/module registry (loadDefinition/unloadIdentifier, modulesByIdentifier, scopesByIdentifier, connectModule/disconnectModule, controllerAttribute), scope-observation delegate duties (createScopeForElementAndIdentifier, scopeConnected, scopeDisconnected, proposeToConnectScopeForElementAndIdentifier over its own scopeObserver), and the event dispatching table (bindingConnected/bindingDisconnected, fetchEventListener/fetchEventListenerMapForEventTarget, cacheKey over eventListenerMaps with an own started flag), in addition to boot/lifecycle, registration, action-option filters, error handling and debug logging. It also exposes a self-referential `dispatcher` accessor kept for call sites that previously consumed the dissolved dispatching object.

dissolved_owner_roles_inlined: event listener table and binding dispatch protocol

excluded.reason: Test fixtures, examples and documentation are not production runtime sources and are outside the scanner's production source directories (src/core, src/multimap, src/mutation-observers).

Generic DOM observation primitives and multimap data structures: cohesive single-purpose classes whose sizes stay far below the rule thresholds; they are the layer beneath the injected coordination smell, not manifestations of it.
The rule counts own non-static members and excludes constructors and class-level statics, so those declaration kinds cannot contribute to a god-class match.
